parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: This is the leg of the pliers, made of steel, forming one of the two handles and jaws of the tool. It is approximately 25 cm long and 2.5 cm wide.
parts.Functional_description: The leg provides leverage and transmits the user's hand force to the jaws for gripping or cutting objects.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the base body to open and close the jaws.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the pliers, made of steel, forming the other half of the tool including one handle and one jaw.
parts.Functional_description: The base body serves as the main structural component, housing the pivot and providing the opposing jaw for gripping or cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed relative to the pivot while the leg moves, allowing the jaws to open and close.
